evidence: Passive phase-change frost protection exists (1984 patent wrapping plants in PCM, 2023 citrus PCM packages), but nothing found using sensor-triggered crystallisation of a supercooled salt solution to protect crops.

A 2007 study on two commercial wood-fired appliances demonstrated thermophoretic particle deposition on cooled surfaces combined with heat recovery from biomass flue gas (lab/field demo, not a cookstove hood product).
Not checked: the web search refused every wording of this query, so whether a version exists is unknown.

Xylem ultrasonic acoustic emissions are well studied as a water-stress signal and a 2011 IEEE paper proposed using them to guide irrigation, but no closed-loop AE-driven irrigation controller was found.

Supercritical CO2 with rapid depressurisation is studied for delaminating PCBs and multilayer films, and old patents use CO2 to dissolve adhesives, but no scCO2 adhesive-foaming disassembly of whole phones was found.
Self-healing coatings release inhibitors from pH- or redox-triggered reservoirs at corrosion sites, but nothing found on capsules migrating to pits by diffusiophoresis.
Scaffold seeding is done by perfusion or capillary flow, and diffusiophoretic colloid deposition in hydrogels is studied, but nothing found on using solute gradients to draw cells into scaffolds.

NASA has tested pneumatic/fluidized conveying of regolith simulant and a 1990s lunar-base paper proposed pumping regolith between pneumatic walls for shielding, but no working shield-filling system was found.
A 2024 paper (Duranay) evaluates vortex-induced-vibration water pumps for irrigation in Turkish rivers and VIV generators were field-tested in a Kerala canal, but no deployed VIV pump was found.
Seeded crystallisation of calcium oxalate in urine is an in-vitro research method and induced-crystallisation risk indices (Bonn Risk Index, iCOCI) exist, but no seeded-crystal home strip was found.
Electrocaloric polymer heat pumps exist only as benchtop devices (Berkeley Lab/UCLA 2025) and scalp cooling uses gel or chiller caps; no electrocaloric wearable or cold cap found.

Patents describe degassing CO2 from acidified seawater (often with vacuum or membranes) and a lake-degassing patent proposes catalysed nucleation, but no nucleation packed bed for seawater CO2 removal was found.

Fraunhofer IKTS and the TreeMon project are developing trunk-mounted acoustic-emission sensor nodes that count wind-induced fibre fractures for tree safety, but no validated failure-warning system yet.
Herbivore-induced green leaf volatiles are detected with e-noses, MOF sensors, portable GC and PTR-MS, but no photoacoustic GLV sensor for pest detection was found.
Evaporation-assisted capillary wicking has been noted as a way to concentrate sweat biomarkers and coffee-ring analyte concentration is patented generally, but no coffee-ring sweat patch was found.
Mechanical pollinators exist (Edete's pollen cannons, air-circulation pollination patents) but none use vortex rings.
Fog harps with superhydrophobic wires are patented and droplet shedding from vibrated vertical wires is studied, but nothing found using wind-driven vortex-induced vibration to shed drops.
A Glasgow group built a handheld device with a magnet and tunnel-magnetoresistance sensor that detects hemozoin label-free (demonstrated on synthetic hemozoin, not yet clinical blood).
Diffusiophoretic removal of bacteria (CO2-driven, Shim and Stone) and solute-gradient cleaning of dead-end pores are studied in the lab, but not applied to wounds or dressings.
Capillary-breakup (CaBER) rheometry of COPD sputum has been studied as an exacerbation biomarker, but no smartphone or point-of-care breakup test was found.
